name: [🔥NEW MYTHIC] Hypershot
desc:
✨Welcome to Hypershot!✨
Jump into our intense and fast paced first person gunfight shooter where skill, style, and chaos rule supreme! 

🏆Dominate in intense classic gamemodes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Free for All, and Gun Game (Arsenal).
💥Team up with friends to challenge rivals to 1v1 or 2v2 duels
👑Climb the ranks to reach the leaderboard!
🌀Master your abilities to outmaneuver and outplay your enemies!
🔥Earn coins and gems to unlock new weapons, skins, abilities, and so much more!
🎮Available on PC, phones, tablets, and console

❤️Made with love by Frosted Studios

⚠️CHEATING OF ANY FORM WILL RESULT IN A BAN ON ALL ACCOUNTS⚠️

*Disclaimer: You will not receive cases in bundles if you live in a country that do not allow the purchase of cases
